en-us.com_furniture_restroom:
The character goes to the restroom to use the toilet and puts their lower garments back on when the command ends
Optionally expels expellable contents (such as semen) from the anus, and whatever the vagina holds above its capacity
Wipes the traces on the lower body and legs: solid traces come off, liquid traces dry into dried marks
NPCs go when their lower body has traces to wipe
en-us.com_furniture_takeShower:
The character takes a shower, restoring Stamina and Energy
Optionally expels expellable contents (such as semen) from the mouth, vagina and anus, and whatever the womb and other organs hold above their capacity
Washes off every temporary trace on the body, dried marks included
NPCs shower only in their free time, once the traces on their body pass their cleanliness tolerance
